units.source_text: 村子里的建筑物飘浮在微明的灯光中，

en.t: The buildings in the village floated in the faint light,

units.source_text: 现在也沿着一条轨迹，只能区别出通道和障碍物两种东西。

en.t: and even now, along a single track, he could distinguish only two things: passageways and obstacles.

units.source_text: 发出声响的，狭窄喉咙间隙流动的风之味……

en.t: The taste of the wind making a sound as it flowed through the narrow gap of his throat...
A warm taste of iron rust...

units.source_text: 眼下就像在要掉落的弯曲断裂的玻璃薄板上，作着绝望的打赌。

en.t: At the moment it was like making a desperate wager on a thin sheet of bent, cracked glass that was about to fall.

units.source_text: 他希望搬运大网篮的家伙们还未出门，

en.t: He hoped the men who carried the large net baskets had not yet set out,
though in fact it was already too late;

units.source_text: 他希望他们全都到海岸那边去，

en.t: he hoped they had all gone over to the shore,
but then it was still too early.

units.source_text: 实际上，刚才并没有听到三轮摩托的声音。

en.t: In fact, just now he had not heard the sound of the three-wheeled motorbike.

units.source_text: 那种疯狂的两缸引擎声音，

en.t: That crazed sound of a two-cylinder engine,

units.source_text: 就是一公里之外也不该听漏。

en.t: was something he should not have missed even from a kilometer away.

units.source_text: 作为条件，眼下实在是坏得不能再坏了。

en.t: As conditions went, things could hardly have been worse right now.
